messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Canary wave 'wave-87' in us-west detected. 5xx rate = 7.2% (1m), healthcheck failures +12% vs baseline. Abort criteria hit: 5xx > 5% sustained 1m. Please respond.

jonathan: Noted. This rollout is f_roll_231 -> runtime v2. Paging oncall.

priya: I'm oncall. Looking now — can you paste the short metrics/snapshot?

jonathan: Quick snapshot:
```metrics
5xx_rate: 7.2%
healthcheck_fail_rate: +12%
p95_latency_ms: 420 (baseline 180)
affected_pods: 8/50
```

sam: Any customer-facing errors or just internal probes?

jonathan: We're seeing customer 502s on a small subset. Example logs:
```
ERROR kv-cache: miss -> downstream 502 (x18)
WARN model-infer timeout 30s (backoff)
```

maya: Okay. I'm going to cut traffic back to v1 and flip the feature flag for the rollout. Executing: `/feature-flag disable f_roll_231` and `deployment stop --id f_roll_231 --scope canary`.

infra-bot: Action recorded: feature-flag f_roll_231 disabled by maya at 2026-03-17T21:39:10Z. Rollout stopped; routing reverted to runtime v1 for 100% traffic in us-west.

priya: I can see 5xx rate falling in the metrics stream already, p95 ~190ms. Opening incident bridge: https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-1873 :rotating_light:

lee: Running verification checks (smoke + health probes) on the rollback path. Will watch 10m and report.

sam: Customer impact summary — a handful of enterprise requests retried, no broad data loss. Pinged CS to monitor incoming tickets.

jonathan: Created postmortem stub: https://redwood/pm/INC-2026-1873 — adding timeline and initial logs.

priya: Good. I'll stay on the bridge for 15m then hand off to lee for the night. If everything stays stable, we'll keep rollouts paused and do a deeper root-cause tomorrow. :thumbsup:

lee: Acknowledged — I'll take over oncall at 21:55 UTC and continue verification.

oncall-bot: ALERT: Condition resolved. 5xx rate returned to baseline; healthcheck failures within normal variance. Canary rollouts remain paused pending postmortem.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short runbook note on the flag / abort steps used.

priya: Closing the urgent pager. I'll update the incident with impact numbers and next steps. :white_check_mark:
